Container.Name: ridepane-browser
Container.Overview: Optional signed-in YouTube browser for Ridepane. Keep it on the private ridepane-desktop Docker network with no published port.

Config.Name: Browser profile
Config.Description: Persistent Chromium profile containing your YouTube sign-in.

Config.Name: Subfolder
Config.Description: Path behind Ridepane's authenticated reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Harden desktop
Config.Description: Disable terminal, sudo, file transfers, and command API.

Config.Name: Harden window manager
Config.Description: Keep the YouTube browser in kiosk mode.

Config.Name: Disable sharing
Config.Description: Do not allow share links for the signed-in browser.

Config.Name: Disable file transfers
Config.Description: Do not expose browser profile files through the web client.

Config.Name: Frame rate
Config.Description: Default remote desktop stream frame rate; adjustable in the client.

Config.Name: Rate control
Config.Description: Adaptive 8 Mbps H.264 stream by default; constant quality is selectable.

Config.Name: Video bitrate
Config.Description: Initial video bitrate in kbps; adapts to the connection under CBR.

Config.Name: Full motion video
Config.Description: Encode each frame for smooth video playback.

Config.Name: Audio bitrate
Config.Description: Opus audio bitrate in bits per second.

Config.Name: Browser title
Config.Description: Title on the browser stream page.

Config.Name: Open YouTube
Config.Description: Launch YouTube full screen in Chromium.
